The '''HMC-15 laser cannon''' was a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] developed by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Standard-issue laser cannons, the HMC-15 fired quickly and accurately at mid-range.
